verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own observe() primitive is documented as discovering actionable elements and returning structured actions that can be executed or validated before acting. This directly delivers the preview-before-commit story. v4 has no autonomous loop, so the developer controls when actions run, and integrations expose a snapshot tool for inspecting page state. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the shape of observe output and on executing an observed action, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the preview workflow.
